site.name: npm-auto-build
site.description: Build your npm project and commit the build output, so you do not commit dist/ by hand.

hero.title: Build it, then commit the output.
hero.lede: A GitHub Action that runs your project's build on a push and commits the build output for you, so nobody commits dist/ by hand. Your build runs without the write token.

features.title: Commit the build output
features.text: Builds, then commits the build output to the checked out branch. The default mode, and the original behavior of the action.

features.title: Fail a stale build
features.text: Builds, then fails when the committed build output is stale. Pushes nothing and reads no token, so it also works for pull requests from forks.

features.title: Keep one pull request
features.text: Builds, then commits the output to a branch of its own and keeps one pull request up to date, for a branch that does not accept direct pushes.

features.title: Only build
features.text: Builds and checks that the output exists. Pushes nothing, needs no write permission and reads no token.

collections.label: Docs
collections.lede: The four modes, the reference, recipes, the changes from v2 and the security documents.

collections.lede: The workflow files of the examples directory.
